gold_labels: Existing human correct / minor / meaning_changed; missing output, UNKNOWN and identity ambiguity excluded and inventoried, never relabeled. W3 METADATA_ONLY maps to minor, not error.
AUROC: Primary: correct vs meaning_changed only, score P(meaning_changed); minors excluded. Also disclose counts. No pooling across categories.
ECE: 10 fixed equal-width bins [0,.1),...,[.9,1]; use P(faithful) against semantic-acceptable indicator (correct/minor=1,meaning_changed=0). No fitted calibration. Include per-bin counts/mean confidence/observed acceptable rate.
verified: P(faithful)>=0.8. Verified material error rate = meaning_changed / all verified (correct+minor+changed); coverage = verified / all eligible test items, including model failed as uncovered. No threshold selected from test.
disputed: If not verified and P(meaning_changed)>=0.5; otherwise unverified. Transport/runtime failure = failed.
confidence_intervals: Wilson95% interval for verified error proportions; undefined AUROC when either class absent. Per-item counts are clustered by source image; do not imply iid prevalence or production error guarantee.
image_policy: Official VJev fit(): long side512; fixed8-source-pixel union-provenance pad for locatable text blocks; page fallback for uncertain geometric mapping; no per-case tuning or upscale.
dev_use: Only format/runtime/shape checking. Never tune correctness, threshold, criteria or calibration on dev. Test only after explicit seal.
time_limits: 2.5h since11:18:03UTC, stop13:48:03UTC. Memory available>=8GiB, CPUthreads2, MPS only, no CPU fallback. One reference forward per item, no retries.
